transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um... I guess I just haven't been feeling right. For a long time now, I've just been walking around with this... flat feeling. It's kind of heavy. Like, even when work is going okay or whatever, I just still feel down most days. Just... empty, I guess.
Have you noticed that you don’t enjoy things as much as you used to, even things you used to really like?
Um... I'm not really sure. I mean, I still do the same stuff I usually do. I haven't really noticed a difference with that, I guess.
Do you feel down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?

Yeah... um, like I was saying before, it's pretty much most days. I just have that... that flat feeling. Even if people are nice to me or whatever, it's just... heavy. I just feel down pretty much all day.
Would you say you feel depressed most days, not just down or flat, but truly depressed?

I don't really know about the word depressed. It's just... like I said, for a really long time I've just been walking around with this flat, heavy feeling. Even if work is going okay or people are nice to me, I still just feel down. Just kind of empty most days. I don't know how else to explain it.
Have you noticed that you don't take pleasure in things you used to enjoy, even slightly, over this period?
Um... I think I already answered that. Like I said, I still do the same things. I haven't really noticed a difference with... enjoying them or not. It's just the same.
Have you been feeling more tired or low on energy lately, even if you’re not doing anything physically demanding?

Yeah... I guess. By the afternoon I get pretty wiped out. Like, even just sitting there fixing a spreadsheet error or finishing up expense paperwork... or trying to get myself to soccer... it just feels like I'm dragging my body and my brain through mud. So... yeah, I guess I'm tired.
Have you been having trouble sleeping lately, like waking up early or not being able to fall asleep, or on the flip side, do you find yourself sleeping a lot more than usual?
No... not really. My sleep is fine. I just sleep my normal amount, I guess. I haven't noticed anything different with it.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the flip side, feeling more restless or agitated lately?
Um... no. Not really. I think I just... talk and move the same as always. I haven't noticed anything like that.
Have you been feeling like you’re not worth much or that you’re letting people down, even when there’s no real reason for it?

I don't know... maybe a little. Like at work, people sometimes bring up this dashboard I built a while ago, and... I don't know, I just feel like I somehow fooled them into thinking it's good. And then if I miss a follow-up or send an email late, it just feels like... like proof that I'm not actually as capable as they think I am. So... yeah, I guess I feel like that sometimes.
Have you found that you don’t really care about things you used to care about, or that you’re not interested in them the way you used to be?
I don't think so. I mean, I still do the same things I usually do. I haven't really noticed a difference.
Have you noticed any trouble thinking clearly, concentrating, or making decisions lately, even with simple things?
No, not really. I think my concentration is fine. I haven't had any issues making decisions or anything like that.
Over the past few weeks, have you found that you don’t get as much pleasure or satisfaction out of things as you used to, even things you normally enjoy?
I don't... I don't really know. I think things are about the same. I haven't really noticed a change.
Over the past two weeks, have you found that you’re less interested in doing things you used to enjoy, even just a little bit?
Um... I feel like you just asked me that. No, not really. I'm just doing my usual routine. I haven't noticed any change.
Would you say that your mood is persistently depressed most of the day, nearly every day, rather than just having periods of feeling down or flat?

Um... yeah, I guess so. That's... that's kind of why I came in, actually. It's just been a really long time of walking around with this... flat, heavy feeling. Like, even if work is going okay, or people are nice to me... I still just feel down. Kind of empty most days. So... yeah.
Over the past two weeks, have you felt less interested in activities you usually enjoy, even just a little bit?
I... I think you keep asking me the same thing. No. Like I said before, I haven't really noticed a change with that. I just do my normal stuff.
Over the past two weeks, have you felt less interested in activities you usually enjoy, even just a little bit?
I... look, you've asked me this three times now. I don't know what else to say. I'm just doing what I normally do. Nothing's changed with that.
Have you noticed that even when you're doing your usual activities, you feel like you're just going through the motions and not really getting anything out of them?
No. I mean... I don't think so. Like I said, I just do my normal routine. I haven't really noticed anything like that.

Can you think back to activities you used to look forward to or enjoy, like hobbies, time with friends, or things like that? Over the past few weeks, have you felt less pleasure or satisfaction from those things, even a little bit?
I... I really don't know what you're looking for here. I don't really have a lot of hobbies anyway. Just... work, mostly. I haven't noticed any difference.
